description: Lists everyone in the project's People (customers, subscribers, people who signed up on its site or in its app, leads, creators, press, people who wrote to its accounts or filled in a form on its ads), every one in a single answer: each with their name, kind, stage, first role and last touch, with the total and the totals by stage. To find one person and their history use crm_search and crm_timeline; their messages are inbox_read.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: list_people
title: List the people
